title: Clarity?
symptom: The user reports that their endocrinologist requires Dexcom Clarity data, and they see an option to log into Clarity in xDrip but cannot get it to work, as it keeps asking for a 10-digit serial number.
cause: The thread indicates that there is no way to upload xDrip+ to Clarity, and that Clarity integration is difficult because Dexcom has Clarity locked down.
evidence_quote: However, at this point there is no way to upload xDrip+ to Clarity.
